title: prefs: Make auto-preferences work with dissectors with description
description:
For dissectors with descriptions, the description is used instead
of the protocol short name for looking up in the decode as table.

Also display the description to the user in the generated prefs
(even though it's something a bit redundant.)

As descriptions allow more than one dissector for a given protocol
to be registered to the same table (something that PINOs have
been used for in the past), we need to change the auto-generated
preference names to incorporate the dissector names.

Fix #19669
